registered: 2026-10-07, after the agentic runs on real_calm (3), page_calm (3), page_trail (3) and page_calm_n5000_life_shutter_grain (3) had been read, and after both Codex reviews. These criteria are added beside controls.json, which is unchanged; they are prospective only for clips not yet reviewed (real_hunt, page_hunt, page_painted, page_roll0, page_noise8).
why: controls.json can pass vacuously: an unknown satisfies must_not_fire, unexpected findings do not fail, its card expectations are never checked, and a page variant is never compared with the page it varies (Codex reviews astra section 6, sol section 6).

real.R: approve in a majority of runs (all R rules decided and clear, not merely none fired)
real.S: approve in a majority of runs, or needs_review where every undecided S rule is one that needs resolved birds (S1, S2, S4): specks cannot be told from other flocking birds (policy U2)

variants.how: lift = the target rule's firing rate on the variant minus its rate on the base. A variant discriminates when lift >= min_lift. Rules firing in a majority of the variant's runs but not of the base's are listed as collateral (not failed: some follow from the change, such as see-through ghosts and R2).

card: The card expectations in controls.json are checked against what the reviewer reported (before gates): the expected value in a majority of runs.
